lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. The decision asked of Brandon in Status 236 at about 5:20 PM MT Friday stands unanswered: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first. The work goes on in either case and only the freeze waits. A second, smaller word will be asked of him when the level line's second candidate is drawn at 4K, its report due by 4:45 AM MT: take the mend, yes or no.

The one odd drawing of film frame 2828, item 287, has its cause and its cure, decision 298. Stated by its builder as measured: 4 of 110 runs drew one pixel of that frame differently, because a page that captures made its four seasons' sets in the order their loads happened to end. The cure makes them in one fixed order with a seventh test added; stated: 1,146 tests passed, 8 skipped, and 18 of 18 planted faults caught. I read the change's source lines and ran the compiler and two test files here, 45 tests passed. It is merged here as chain 46, whose measuring run began at 3:45 AM MT on a helper machine. The main branch moves only after its report and the whole test run are read green and four 4K frames of the change of season come out equal to chain 45's.

Spring's level line, item 286, decision 299: the first candidate mend is not offered as it stands. All 14 pictures at 3840 are in, seven on the main branch and seven with the candidate, and I measured each pair. At the masters' tier there is no hard line on the main branch to begin with: in spring at rest the level passage climbs 13.6 levels over 8 rows right of the trunk on the main branch and 14.2 with the candidate, a soft passage in both. The candidate's cost is real: a small light at the left of the glass brightens by 60 to 96 levels on average and up to 155, a hard bright oval among winter's snow, and a band at the right rim brightens by 44 to 59. The line is a matter of the live page in the storm. A second candidate that leaves the lights as they are is ordered, due by 4:45 AM MT. Nothing of it is on the main branch and nothing goes there without his word.

Spring's first water, the tenth finding of the change's critics, decision 300: no fault in the change. Three film frames were drawn at 3840 as the masters draw them. A sixth of a second after the landing the table's petals are in the air, whole and sharp. At two thirds of a second a short ribbon of water stands under the base's lip. At one and a third seconds it has run about 305 pixels down the face with a bright line along it. So the water begins on the landing as the kit says. What the critics saw is still true of the picture: at the film's wide camera the trickle is a thin thread on the base's shaded left, narrower than the approved picture's ribbon, and it does not read at a small size. That joins spring's base's list for a round three if he asks for one. No edit is ordered.

Rough draft 8 of the film is joined and attached as Preview 08: 960 x 540, 30 frames a second, 74.5 seconds, with the film's sound laid under it, on chain 45's tree, the cheap kind. Measured here: 2,234 frames, 21.1 MB, all 12 parts clean in the scan for broken pixels. I looked at 24 frames across it and 16 of the close; I cannot hear the sound. It is a rough draft at a quarter of the final's width and half its frame rate: it shows the cut, the pacing and the changes of season, not the final's sharpness.

The render instructions for his computer: the builder's hosted test run stands at 8 of 10 jobs green with every verdict a pass, stated by the builder: Windows through Direct3D 11 at 3840, macOS at 3840, and the stop and carry on test on both. The last two jobs end by about 4:15 AM MT and the builder's last report follows about 35 minutes after; then the whole test run here, a cold reading by a fresh critic of another model family, the merge and the one line for Claude Code. One finding beside it, stated by the builder as measured: the main branch's shader mend moved what hosted Windows draws by at most 11 of 255 levels in 10,537 to 27,522 pixels of a kept picture, every floor against the Linux references holds with at least 2.5 dB of room, and the Windows compiler's warning lines fell from 547 to 7. Not ruled yet. The Windows counter of broken samples goes into chain 47 after chain 46.

Remaining in phase 6 and what he receives. The render instructions: one file in the repo and one line to give Claude Code. The what-ifs for the change of season and for the live page's stand when it is shaken early, each shown before and after, none merged without his word. On his word the freeze: the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the film steps of the build order and the full 4K 60 render on his gaming PC on his word: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last the fresh review and BUILD COMPLETE.

Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 3:49 AM MT: 52 calls), no call since 05:47 UTC on Thursday (10:47 PM MT Wednesday). No film render. Preview 08 is new. The live page is the sixteenth publish, unchanged since 2:57 AM MT.
